plainLanguage: Section 84 (Going armed in public) inaweka offence/kanuni inayohusiana na public tranquility. Maana yake lazima isomwe kwa exact statutory elements zilizowekwa kwenye official text.
meaning: Liability under section 84 depends on proof of the conduct, circumstances and any mental or contextual threshold expressly stated by the provision.
keyPoints: Official title: Going armed in public.
The statutory wording should be applied element by element.
Any stated penalty, qualification or cross-reference must be read together with the offence.

history.summary: Section 84 appears in Chapter IX of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The offence label alone is insufficient; each statutory element should be matched to evidence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Public-order offences often depend on context-specific thresholds expressly stated in the section, which should not be broadened by assumption.

debateQuestion: Je, facts zinathibitisha kila statutory element ya section 84?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
